# pipecat-maya integration instructions

Source of truth: https://github.com/MayaResearch/pipecat-maya
Provider contract: https://www.mayaresearch.ai/llm.txt
Pipecat conventions: https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/blob/main/COMMUNITY_INTEGRATIONS.md

Install: pip install "pipecat-maya @ git+https://github.com/MayaResearch/pipecat-maya.git@v0.1.0"
Compatibility: Python >=3.11; pipecat-ai==1.8.1. This GitHub release is not a PyPI release.

Minimal integration:
    import os
    from pipecat_maya import MayaTTSService
    tts = MayaTTSService(api_key=os.environ["MAYA_API_KEY"])
Insert tts after llm and before transport.output() in an existing Pipecat pipeline.
Feed normal LLMFullResponseStartFrame, LLMTextFrame tokens, LLMFullResponseEndFrame.
Use TTSSpeakFrame for an entire known utterance. Never send socket frames yourself.
Use standard Pipecat turn detection and output transport so InterruptionFrame clears playback.
Only the TTS smoke example needs MAYA_API_KEY; conversational STT/LLM/transport credentials belong to the application's selected providers.
Run: python examples/speak.py --text 'Hello from Maya.' --language en --output hello.wav

Defaults: model="Maya 2 Native", voice="Ananya", language=None, speed=None.
Settings: MayaTTSService.Settings(model=..., voice=..., language=..., speed=...).
Runtime updates: TTSUpdateSettingsFrame(delta=MayaTTSService.Settings(...)).
Unspecified fields retain their values; None resets language to auto-detect or Native speed to 1.0.
Calyx example: Settings(model="Maya Calyx", voice="Aarav", speed=None).
All models/voices/languages are exported as MODELS and LANGUAGES; exact-case validation applies.
Mixed language: omit language or set None. English code en means Indian English.
Plain text only, no SSML/HTML/Markdown; preserve natural numbers and dates.

sample_rate is Pipecat output PCM rate; default 24000. Local continuous resampling flushes its tail.
WebSocket input stays at documented PCM defaults. Never request Native WS mulaw/8k: metadata may misdescribe actual bytes.
HTTP: from pipecat_maya import MayaHttpTTSService; same settings schema.
For Calyx HTTP only: provider_sample_rate=8000|16000|24000, encoding="pcm_s16le"|"mulaw".
HTTP always decodes actual response content-type and yields PCM. Let the carrier serializer encode telephony output.

Cancellation drops local pending audio immediately, sends targeted cancels, and discards stale replies.
Reconnection never replays an interrupted/uncertain utterance. Start a fresh LLM turn after a failed context.
Settings updates finish submitted speech and establish a new WS session; prefer between-turn updates.
Do not retry 400/401. No replay after any HTTP audio body bytes. Bound retries/timeouts.
No pitch, SSML, seed, manual region, word timestamps, or phoneme API is claimed.
Observe ErrorFrame and on_pipeline_error, not only HTTP 200/end. Zero audio is failure.
Support identifiers: WS session_id + context_id; HTTP last_request_id. Never log secrets.
See README.md, docs/api-coverage.md and docs/validation.md for complete details and evidence.
